name: trace.related
title: Show related elements
summary: All children of a set of parents, or all parents of a set of requirements, each once, optionally up to a depth; one page at a time, total counts all.

refs.description: The elements to start from: the parents for `children`, the requirements for `parents`.

direction.description: `children`: every element derived from them. `parents`: every element they derive from.

maxDepth.description: The most derivation steps from the start elements; without it every step.

view.description: Only the elements that this view holds: `core` or a variant ID; without it every element.

limit.description: Elements of the page; total counts all.

offset.description: Elements skipped before the page, in the order of the list (by distance from the selection).

total.description: The number of all related elements; `elements` holds the page.
